verdicts.reason: A rearranges the design well for the portrait canvas. The can, headline, subcopy and CTA are stacked with even gaps and the tagline now has proper room above the button. Its only flaws are the slightly heavy NEW FLAVOR badge and the large decorative circle crowding the logo area. B shrinks the can and type too much and pushes the NEW FLAVOR badge down so it floats beside the logo with no clear alignment. It also jams the tagline against the CTA, which nearly touch, and leaves a dead band of about 100px at the bottom.
